# netskope_aig_token_list (Data Source)

Lists all AI Gateway tokens in the Netskope tenant. The `token` value is never included in list responses.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "netskope_aig_token_list" "my_aigtokenlist" {
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `elements` (Attributes List) List of tokens (no token value included). (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--elements))

<a id="nestedatt--elements"></a>
### Nested Schema for `elements`

Read-Only:

- `enabled` (Boolean) Whether the token is active.
- `expire_time` (String) Timestamp when the token expires. Null if no expiry.
- `id` (String) Unique identifier for the token.
- `name` (String) Name of the token.
- `token_group_id` (String) ID of the token group this token belongs to.
